night_start.name: {name}
night_start.text: *Back in my room. Lying on the bed. For a first day — I'm wiped. But it's not bad.*

night_msg_seo_3.name: Seoyeon
night_msg_seo_3.text: *Next time I'll at least have drinks ready*

night_msg_seo_5.name: {name}
night_msg_seo_5.text: *She sent 'On the house' as its own line on purpose.*

night_msg_yuna_3.name: {name}
night_msg_yuna_3.text: *'I'll save your seat.' — The hand setting down the phone moves slowly.*

night_msg_dain_3.name: Dain
night_msg_dain_3.text: *Still bummed about the bread money honestly lolol*

night_msg_dain_4.name: {name}
night_msg_dain_4.text: *Three messages in a row. Can she not breathe between texts?*

night_late_transition.name: {name}
night_late_transition.text: *About to fall asleep when — my phone buzzes one more time.*

night_seo_late_2.name: Seoyeon
night_seo_late_2.text: *— If you don't show up, I'm coming to find you*

night_seo_late_3.name: {name}
night_seo_late_3.text: *The hand that put the phone down stops.*

night_yuna_late_2.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_2.text: *Just '...' and nothing else. Like she typed something and erased it.*

night_yuna_late_3.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_3.text: *— I debate replying, and the screen goes dark.*

night_yuna_late_4.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_4.text: *Even after the screen went dark, I held the phone for a long time.*

night_dain_late_4.name: {name}
night_dain_late_4.text: *Does this person not have the concept of refusal?*

night_end_1.name: {name}
night_end_1.text: *I put the phone down. I look at the ceiling. The smell of cherry blossoms still lingers on my uniform.*

night_end_3.name: {name}
night_end_3.text: *Not a bad first day. Tomorrow — looks like it's going to be a little more fun.*

night_hidden_check.name: {name}
night_hidden_check.text: *Between the messenger notifications — I notice something else.*

night_hidden_homeroom_1.name: {name}
night_hidden_homeroom_1.text: *There's a post from the homeroom teacher on the school app. 'Class 3-2 Notice: Bring math supplies for 1st period tomorrow. — And {name}, as long as you're settling in okay, that's enough.'*

night_hidden_homeroom_2.name: {name}
night_hidden_homeroom_2.text: *A personal message inside a class announcement? — The corners of my mouth lift. I try to hide it but can't.*

night_hidden_nurse_1.name: {name}
night_hidden_nurse_1.text: *There's an alert in the school health app. 'Nurse's Office Record: {name} — Dizziness (mild). Note: Come back tomorrow if the symptoms continue. Drink plenty of water. — the ♥ is purely a medical concern ^^'*

night_hidden_nurse_2.name: {name}
night_hidden_nurse_2.text: *A school nurse who puts hearts in medical records. Never seen anyone use emojis in health files before.*

night_dain_late_4_b.name: {name}
night_dain_late_4_b.text: *A string of emojis trails below Dain's message. Every single one is different.*
